## Distro package

is the root object of a distro package configuration document.

Rendered from `schema/zarf-v1alpha1-distro-package-schema.json`.

<div class="schema-table">

| Property     | Type                                        | Required | Default | Description                                                                                      |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |

| `build`      | [ZarfDistroBuildData](#zarfdistrobuilddata) | no       |         | holds information recorded when the package was built.                                           |
| `kind`       | `string`                                    | yes      |         | identifies the document type. The value must be ZarfDistro. One of `ZarfDistro`.                 |
| `metadata`   | [ZarfDistroMetadata](#zarfdistrometadata)   | yes      |         | holds identifying information for the distro package.                                            |
| `spec`       | [ZarfDistroSpec](#zarfdistrospec)           | yes      |         | holds the configuration for the distro package.                                                  |

</div>

### Arches

### BinarySelector

selects which files to upload to a host, based on host role and install method.

<div class="schema-table">

| Property  | Type              | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                   |
| --------- | ----------------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `arch`    | [Arches](#arches) | no       |         | lists the CPU architectures this file applies to. An empty list means every architecture the package targets. |
| `package` | `string`          | no       |         | selects which install method receives this file: rpm, apt, or binary. One of `rpm`, `apt`, `binary`.          |
| `profile` | `string`          | no       |         | selects which host role receives this file: worker or controller. One of `worker`, `controller`.              |
| `roles`   | array of `string` | no       |         | lists the host roles this file applies to.                                                                    |

</div>

### ZarfDistroBuildData

holds information recorded when the package was built.

<div class="schema-table">

| Property            | Type                | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ------------------- | ------------------- | -------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `architecture`      | `string`            | no       |         | is the CPU architecture used to build the package. Populated only when the package targets a single architecture. One of `amd64`, `arm64`, `riscv64`.                                                                                     |
| `architectures`     | [Arches](#arches)   | no       |         | lists the CPU architectures used to build the package.                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `fileOverrides`     | map[string]`string` | no       |         | maps each source URL prefix to the mirror or local directory files were<br>downloaded from instead. Like RegistryOverrides, this records the overrides that were<br>configured for the build, not which one resolved any particular file. |
| `provenanceFiles`   | array of `string`   | no       |         | lists files in the package that checksums.txt does not cover.<br>These are files added after cargoship generates checksums, for example signature files.<br>The signed distro.yaml authenticates this list.                               |
| `registryOverrides` | map[string]`string` | no       |         | maps each original registry to the registry actually used to build the package.                                                                                                                                                           |
| `reproducible`      | `boolean`           | no       |         | indicates Build.Timestamp was pinned to a fixed value<br>(config.Timestamp) instead of the actual build time, so identical<br>package inputs produce byte-identical output.                                                               |
| `signed`            | `boolean`           | no       |         | indicates whether the package was signed. A nil value means the signing status was not recorded.                                                                                                                                          |
| `timestamp`         | `string`            | no       |         | is the time the package was created.                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `version`           | `string`            | no       |         | records the distro version used to build the package.                                                                                                                                                                                     |

</div>

### ZarfDistroMetadata

holds identifying information for a distro package.

<div class="schema-table">

| Property            | Type                | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                                                           |
| ------------------- | ------------------- | -------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `aggregateChecksum` | `string`            | no       |         | is the checksum of the checksums.txt file, which lists the checksum for every layer in the package.                                                   |
| `annotations`       | map[string]`string` | no       |         | holds key-value pairs added to the OCI manifest.                                                                                                      |
| `architecture`      | `string`            | no       | `amd64` | is the CPU architecture this distro package targets. Use Architectures to target more than one. One of `amd64`, `arm64`, `riscv64`.                   |
| `architectures`     | [Arches](#arches)   | no       |         | lists the CPU architectures this distro package targets. It supersedes Architecture, which stays valid for a package targeting a single architecture. |
| `athors`            | `string`            | no       |         | sets the OCI annotation for the contact details of the people or organization responsible for the image.                                              |
| `description`       | `string`            | no       |         | explains what this distro package does.                                                                                                               |
| `documentation`     | `string`            | no       |         | sets the OCI annotation for the URL to the image documentation.                                                                                       |
| `name`              | `string`            | yes      |         | identifies the distro package.                                                                                                                        |
| `source`            | `string`            | no       |         | sets the OCI annotation for the URL to the image source code.                                                                                         |
| `uncompressed`      | `boolean`           | no       |         | disables compression for this package when true.                                                                                                      |
| `url`               | `string`            | no       |         | sets the OCI annotation for more information about the image.                                                                                         |
| `vendor`            | `string`            | no       |         | sets the OCI annotation for the name of the organization or individual that distributes the image.                                                    |
| `version`           | `string`            | no       |         | is the distro version cargoship installs. We recommend matching it to the Kubernetes version you install.                                             |

</div>

### ZarfDistroValueMapping

projects one value onto one place in the engine configuration.

<div class="schema-table">

| Property | Type     | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                   |
| -------- | -------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `source` | `string` | yes      |         | is the dotted path to read from the resolved values, e.g. .cilium.encryption.enabled                          |
| `target` | `string` | yes      |         | is the dotted path to write, relative to spec.config.engine,<br>e.g. .manifest.rke2-cilium.encryption.enabled |

</div>

### ZarfDistroValues

declares the values a package ships with.

<div class="schema-table">

| Property   | Type                                                       | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| ---------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `files`    | array of `string`                                          | no       |         | lists the YAML values files cargoship merges, in order, to build the package's default values. Each entry is a path relative to the package definition, an absolute path, or a URL. A later file overrides an earlier one, key by key.                                                                                                                                                         |
| `mappings` | array of [ZarfDistroValueMapping](#zarfdistrovaluemapping) | no       |         | project values onto the engine configuration, so that one value a<br>cluster sets reaches wherever the distro needs it. Each mapping reads the<br>source path out of the resolved values and writes it to the target path,<br>which is relative to spec.config.engine. A source the values do not define<br>is left alone, so the package's own engine configuration stands as the<br>default. |
| `schema`   | `string`                                                   | no       |         | is the JSON Schema document the merged values must satisfy. Cargoship checks the values against it when it builds the package, and refuses to build when they do not match. The schema must not use $ref.                                                                                                                                                                                      |

</div>

### ZarfFile

defines a file shared by the distro and cluster APIs.

<div class="schema-table">

| Property      | Type                              | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ------------- | --------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `data`        | `string`                          | no       |         | holds the inline file content.                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `executable`  | `boolean`                         | no       |         | sets executable permissions on the file when true.                                                                                                                                                           |
| `extractPath` | `string`                          | no       |         | is the path cargoship extracts from a tarball.                                                                                                                                                               |
| `group`       | `string`                          | no       |         | is the group that owns the file.                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `isDirectory` | `boolean`                         | no       |         | indicates that Target is a directory. Cargoship uses this mainly for image uploads.                                                                                                                          |
| `name`        | `string`                          | no       |         | identifies the file entry. It is not the file name on disk.                                                                                                                                                  |
| `perm`        | any                               | no       |         | sets the permissions cargoship applies to the file. It accepts an octal string or an integer, for example "0644" or 644.                                                                                     |
| `selector`    | [BinarySelector](#binaryselector) | no       |         | controls whether cargoship uploads this file to a given node.                                                                                                                                                |
| `shasum`      | `string`                          | no       |         | verifies the file when cargoship sources the distro package.                                                                                                                                                 |
| `source`      | `string`                          | yes      |         | is the path where cargoship finds the file when it creates the package.                                                                                                                                      |
| `symlinks`    | array of `string`                 | no       |         | lists the symlinks cargoship creates that point to Target.                                                                                                                                                   |
| `target`      | `string`                          | yes      |         | is the path on the remote host where cargoship writes the file.                                                                                                                                              |
| `template`    | `boolean`                         | no       |         | renders the file's contents as a Go template against the package's values before cargoship uploads it. It defaults to false, because most files are binaries or archives that a template pass would corrupt. |
| `user`        | `string`                          | no       |         | is the user that owns the file.                                                                                                                                                                              |

</div>

is an ordered list of files.
